interface.description: Primary network interface for SSDP traffic (e.g., eth0, br0). Must be specified to avoid ambiguous multicast behavior.

port.description: TCP port for HTTP-based UPnP device discovery (RFC 2324). Standard value is 80.

ssdp_address.description: IPv4 address the daemon binds to for receiving SSDP multicast notifications. Use a specific interface IP or `0.0.0.0` for all.

max_entries.description: Maximum number of UPnP devices to cache. Increase for large networks with many devices.

logging.description: Whether to log events (e.g., device additions/removals) to syslog. Recommended for production.

extra_interfaces.description: List of additional interfaces for SSDP monitoring (e.g., for VLANs, bridges, or multi-homed setups).

name.description: Descriptive label for this interface entry (e.g., 'dmz-vlan', 'iot-bridge').

device.description: Actual network device name (e.g., eth1.100, br-lan).

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for the daemon process. Ensure writable by the daemon user.

daemon_args.description: Extra command-line arguments passed to the minissdpd daemon (e.g., `-d` to daemonize, `-f` to stay in foreground for debugging).
